response.justification: While the candidate exceeds the required 15 years of software engineering experience and meets baseline qualifications, the role requires specialized AI strategy expertise that is not clearly demonstrated. Recent AI infrastructure work with agent frameworks shows emerging relevant experience, but lacks the advanced education, demonstrated AI products, and strategic customer advisory background expected for this director-level AI-focused position.
strengths: Current hands-on experience with AI agent infrastructure, MCP code generators, and agentic workflow frameworks
20+ years of diverse full-stack software engineering across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure domains
Proven entrepreneurial mindset through founding and maintaining GISCollective open-source geospatial platform
concerns: Lacks Master's or PhD in AI-related field and no formal AI education demonstrated
No track record of building or shipping recognized AI-powered products or platforms
Recent AI involvement (4 months at current role) appears infrastructure-focused rather than strategic product development
